  WHY: The test claims presence of basename reference but passes even if `"out-a"` is not a path segment, misleading diagnostics when combined with regex normalization expecting isolated `"out-a/"`.

  WHY: If basename contains Unicode letters (e.g., `café-out`), prior non-ASCII char skips replacement, leaving mismatch after sub while `files_b` normalizes correctly, test falsely fails.
